name: manual_fecadd
claim: Vetting a candidate means more than checking the evaluator's score. Strip dead handlers (a try/except around a function that cannot raise for validated input, which would report a misleading reason if it ever fired), bound every diagnostic that prints user-controlled text (a 72-character cap per entry), and re-check that a candidate did not drop a guard the previous version had. The evaluator did not test either of these and both were found by reading the candidate before incorporating it.
conditions: vet candidate dead code unbounded diagnostic regression incorporate

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: the turn-2 candidate carried a dead except Exception returning an E_OWNER message; the turn-3b candidate dropped the 72-character truncation so a 6000-character entry gave a huge message; both were fixed test-first at incorporation.
